==Description==
The '''Railgunner''' was an unreleased tower that was in the game before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]].

Not all information is available about the '''Railgunner'''. Through its appearance and known statistics (which are at least partially copied from the pre [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]] [[Ranger|Outlaw]]), it appears to be a cliff tower that would have functioned similarly to the [[Ranger|Outlaw]].

==Trivia==
*The '''Railgunner''' was banished into the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]], as the Level 5 model of its railgun can be found as one of the discarded props in [[Banlands]].
*The overall appearance of the '''Railgunner''' strongly resembles the first few versions of the {{Color|Mission|Railgunner}} [[Ranger|Outlaw]], especially at Level 0-3.
**Certain items like the weapon it wields appear to be mostly the same between skins.
